apps.name: eFootball™

**eFootball™** represents a new evolution in digital soccer gaming, building upon the legacy of the popular PES series. Experience the next generation of soccer simulation with immersive gameplay that delivers realistic action and tactical depth on your iOS device.
This game welcomes both newcomers and seasoned players with an engaging step-by-step tutorial that teaches the basic controls through practical demonstrations. Complete the tutorial and be rewarded with the legendary player Lionel Messi to jumpstart your team.

This feature ensures that everyone can experience the thrill of soccer regardless of expertise.

**Start Off With Your Favorite Team:** Choose your preferred club or national team from regions including Europe, the Americas, and Asia to begin your journey.**Sign Players:** Build your dream team by signing current superstars and legendary soccer icons. Strategically assemble a squad capable of competing at the highest levels.**Playing Matches:** Take your team to the pitch and challenge the AI or dive into intense Online Matches to compete for rankings and showcase your skills.**Player Development:** Develop your players based on their types by participating in matches or utilizing in-game items to earn Progression Points. Allocate these points manually to customize players precisely, or use the Recommended function for automatic distribution that suits the player’s strengths.## For More Fun
**Weekly Live Updates:** Keep your squad current with weekly updates that mirror real-world player transfers and match achievements. Adapt your team dynamically to remain competitive.**Customize a Stadium:** Personalize your home stadium by selecting various Stadium Elements like Tifos and Giant Props. Watch your customized visuals come to life during matches, adding vibrant atmosphere and flair to your gaming experience.
**Important Notes:** Users residing in Belgium or Brazil (under 18 years old) will not have access to loot boxes requiring eFootball™ Coins. Additionally, an internet connection is mandatory for gameplay, and a stable connection is highly recommended to enjoy uninterrupted matches.
Before downloading, ensure you have approximately 3.2 GB of free storage space available. It is advisable to use a Wi-Fi connection to download the base game and any future updates smoothly.

**Continuous Improvements:** The game will receive ongoing updates introducing new features, modes, events, and gameplay enhancements to keep the soccer experience fresh and exciting.

Big heads, tiny pitches and a very long shot list: **Head Soccer** is one of the most downloaded arcade sports games on iOS. Download the Head Soccer IPA for iPhone with unlimited money and buy upgrades without grinding for coins first. The build is shared by iOSGods, the modding community behind it.
## About Head Soccer
Head Soccer is made by D&D Dream Corp. and appeared in the App Store back in 2012, which makes it older than most of the games around it in the Sports and Casual sections. Its premise is simple on purpose. Two oversized heads face each other across a short field, you move, jump and kick, and the first to outscore the other wins. Physics decides how the ball bounces, so a lucky rebound can matter as much as a planned shot.
The depth comes from the extras. The developer lists 103 avatars, and each has its own special shot, with the dragon shot, ice shot and lightning shot named on the store page. The developer counts eight game modes, among them Arcade, Tournament, Survival and League, plus Head Cup, Death Mode, Fight Mode and the Awaken Mode. A pet system and a body system let you stack bonuses, and leaderboards through Game Center make scores comparable.
Multiplayer comes in two forms: a Bluetooth mode for friends in the same room and online matches over Game Center.
The studio behind it, D&D Dream Games, has a catalog that also includes Head Basketball, a sibling in the same big-head sports style, which shows how long this formula has worked for them.
---

apps.name: Cytus II
apps.localizedDescription:
**Cytus II** is an immersive music rhythm game developed by Rayark Games, continuing the legacy of its predecessor, **Cytus**. This sequel features a captivating story and innovative gameplay that blends rhythm challenges with a futuristic narrative.
Set in a future where human life is deeply interconnected with the digital internet world, **Cytus II** invites players to dive into the expansive virtual internet space cyTus. Here exists the enigmatic DJ legend Æsir, whose music captivates people's souls with every note and beat. When Æsir announces the first-ever mega virtual concert, Æsir-FEST, over millions of people connect to witness this historic event, breaking world records for simultaneous connections. The game’s storyline unfolds alongside this spectacular musical phenomenon.
---
## Unique Gameplay Mechanics
The game features a distinctive **"Active Judgement Line"** rhythm gameplay style. Players tap notes precisely when the judgement line intersects them to score points. With five different types of notes and a judgement line that dynamically adjusts speed in sync with the music's beat, players experience a harmonious mix of rhythm and melody that enhances immersion and challenge.
## Extensive Song Library
**Cytus II** offers a rich collection of over 250 high-quality songs contributed by composers from all over the world including Japan, Korea, the US, Europe, and Taiwan. Covering a diverse range of genres such as electronic, rock, and classical, the game delivers an eclectic and satisfying musical experience to fans of rhythm games.
## Varied Difficulty Levels
With more than 800 unique charts designed to accommodate different skill levels—from beginners to experts—players can find exciting challenges tailored to their ability. Each chart brings its own sensation through unique timing and rhythm sequences, providing endless entertainment and skill progression.
## Engaging Story Mode
The **"iM"** story system allows players to explore the virtual internet world alongside the game's distinctive characters. Gradually unveiling the mystery behind the world of **Cytus II**, the narrative is delivered through cinematic visuals and compelling dialogue. Players will connect with characters such as:
PAFF (voice actress: Sumire Uesaka)NEKO (voice actress: Yumiri Hanamori)Xenon (voice actor: Tomokazu Seki)ConneR (voice actor: Eiji Takeuchi)Cherry (voice actress: Fairouz Ai)Nora (voice actress: Manaka Iwami)Ivy (voice actress: Maki Kawase)Vanessa (voice actress: Tomori Kusunoki)Rin (voice actress: Mamiko Noto)## Additional Information
Cytus II contains mild violence and vulgar language and is suitable for players aged 15 and above. To ensure fair play, the game periodically performs connection authentications for In-App Purchases (IAP). If any purchased content appears missing, reconnect your device to the internet and use the "Restore Purchases" option within the game.
Please enjoy Cytus II responsibly by monitoring your game time and avoiding overuse. This game should not be used for gambling or other illegal activities.

apps.name: Apollo
apps.localizedDescription:
**Apollo** was a beloved iOS app designed for an exceptional Reddit browsing experience from 2015 through 2023. Over nearly a decade, it earned immense appreciation and loyalty from the Reddit community, reflected by over 100,000 five-star ratings and numerous accolades. The app was known for its intuitive design, powerful functionality, and commitment to enhancing user interaction with Reddit content.
In 2023, significant changes to Reddit's API pricing policy dramatically altered the landscape for third-party developers. With a sudden shift from a free API to potentially millions of dollars in annual fees and only 30 days’ notice, Apollo’s continued operation became unsustainable. As a result, the app was gracefully retired after years of delivering an outstanding user experience.
---
## Current State of the Apollo App
Although no longer active for browsing Reddit, Apollo now serves as a commemorative platform celebrating its legacy and the incredible community that supported it. Upon opening the app, users are greeted with a heartfelt thank you message from the developer, Christian Selig, expressing deep gratitude for the support over the years.
The app includes a **Goodbye Apollo wallpaper pack** available for unlocking, offering unique visuals as a tribute to the app’s history. Users who had Apollo previously downloaded can export their data by simply shaking their device, preserving personal information and memories from their time using the app.
Additionally, all previous Apollo app icons have been automatically unlocked, allowing users to personalize their app experience with nostalgic designs. Beyond these features, the app functions as a central hub to stay updated about other projects and developments by Christian Selig.
---
## Why Apollo Was Special
**Intuitive User Interface:** Built specifically for iOS, Apollo delivered seamless navigation and smooth interactions optimized for iPhones and iPads.**Rich Feature Set:** Including customizable views, efficient content browsing, multi-account support, and comprehensive notification settings.**Community-Driven Development:** The app evolved continuously with user feedback, making it a trusted tool cherished by millions.**Legacy and Impact:** Apollo’s influence on Reddit app design and standards remains significant, inspiring other iOS developers.
---
## Thank You for Being Part of the Journey
The retirement of Apollo marks the end of an era, but the memories and impact it created endure. The developer remains committed to delivering quality experiences through future projects, and this app continues to connect users to those updates.
Thank you for the incredible journey, the support, and the community spirit that made Apollo more than just an app — a shared experience treasured by thousands worldwide.

Match your way across the map in **Triple Tile** without ads breaking your flow. Download the Triple Tile mod IPA for iPhone and play with boosters that never run out.
## About Triple Tile
Triple Tile is a tile-matching puzzle by Tripledot Studios, listed in the App Store under Games with Puzzle and Casual tags and called Triple Tile: Match Puzzle Game there. The rule fits in one sentence: find three identical tiles and combine them to take them off the board, and keep going until the layout is empty.
The challenge comes from the layouts. Levels stack tiles in layers, hide some pieces behind others and add twists, so a quick tap on the nearest match is not always the right one. The game stresses a calm, brain-training feel with thousands of levels and new puzzles added every week.
Progress is shown on a map. As you clear levels you unlock new destinations, from beaches to forests, and each chapter swaps in a different backdrop. The game also works offline, which suits a commute or a flight.
Tripledot positions the game around four ideas: a relaxing tap-and-match rhythm, a puzzle that trains attention, a travel-style map that gives a sense of progress, and a steady flow of fresh levels. It targets both casual players and anyone who already enjoys match-3 style games, and the age rating in the store is 12+.
---

DolphiniOS runs GameCube and Wii games on an iPhone or iPad. It is the official iOS build of the open-source Dolphin project — the same emulator people run on desktop — now on build 5.0.0b6 with the Dolphin 2509 core.
Read this part before you install. Playable speed needs JIT, and Apple does not hand JIT to sideloaded apps on its own. You enable it with a separate free app called StikDebug (version 2.3.0 or newer on iOS 26), which needs a pairing file generated once on a computer, after which you tap Enable JIT in StikDebug each time before launching. Without JIT the emulator still runs through its Cached Interpreter, just slower. This is the one app in our emulator shelf that asks something of you up front — Delta, PPSSPP and emuThreeDS do not.
What you get once it is set up: full GameCube and Nintendo Wii support, save states so you can stop anywhere and pick it up later, accurate controller support for the pads you already own, and screen orientation handling for both phone and tablet.

Open source, built on the Dolphin project

Happy Scale uses advanced mathematical algorithms to smooth out daily fluctuations and reveal the genuine trend of your weight loss over time. This allows you to objectively see the progress you've made each week, helping you stay motivated and confident that your efforts are paying off.

Weight loss plateaus can be discouraging, but with the moving average progress tracking options, Happy Scale helps you visualize steady progress every day, even when the raw numbers seem stuck. This feature takes the sting out of plateaus by showing a smoother trend of your weight changes.

You can automatically import weight entries from apps that export to Apple Health, and Happy Scale will export your weight data back to Apple Health, allowing other apps to access your information and promote a holistic health overview.

This app also provides predictions of your future weight based on your current trends, empowering you to visualize your success and set realistic commitment goals. These forecasts help you stay focused on your targets and maintain a forward-looking perspective.
## Know Your Numbers
With the built-in BMI calculator, Happy Scale shows you exactly where you stand in relation to various health categories. This eliminates the guesswork and makes it clear what weight ranges you should aim for to improve your health.
## Works on All Your Devices
Enjoy seamless synchronization between your iPhone and iPad, so your weight tracking is always up-to-date, no matter which device you use.
---
Happy Scale offers optional integration with Apple Health, which can be enabled from the Settings menu for enhanced data management and connectivity.
If you have struggled with motivation or confusing weight fluctuations, **Happy Scale** provides the tools you need to tame the scale and confidently pursue your weight loss goals. Join thousands of users who trust Happy Scale to support their health journey.

**Uncover the mysteries of live air traffic** with Plane Finder, a beautiful and easy-to-use app designed exclusively for iOS. Whether you're a casual observer or an aviation enthusiast, Plane Finder allows you to identify any plane in the sky and access detailed live flight information instantly.
Plane Finder offers intuitive real-time tracking of almost any aircraft, providing you with its current location, altitude, speed, and heading. The app's functionality extends beyond simple tracking. **Plane Finder’s augmented reality (AR) mode** lets you point your iPhone camera at the sky and instantly view detailed live information about planes overhead. Designed with full support for iOS’s Dark Mode, the app is perfectly suited for both daytime and nighttime use, providing a stunning interface that is easy on the eyes while maintaining excellent readability.
---
## Key Features
**Live Global Flight Tracking**: Track flights worldwide in real time with accurate status updates displayed on a detailed map.**3D Flight Tracking**: Instantly switch to immersive 3D views for any aircraft or location to see flights like never before.**Live AR Mode**: Use augmented reality to identify aircraft by pointing your device to the sky, revealing live flight and technical data.**Extensive Airport Information**: Access live arrival and departure boards, terminal details, gate and baggage info, plus real-time weather conditions at hundreds of airports.**Comprehensive Technical Data**: Dive into in-depth technical details about aircraft and flights, enriching your experience and knowledge.**Customizable Alerts**: Create unlimited notifications for your favorite flights or aircraft to never miss an important event.**Unlimited Global Playback**: Replay flights and explore fascinating historical air traffic data dating back to 2011.**Powerful Filters**: Simplify your view by applying filters to focus on specific airlines, aircraft types, routes, and more.**Custom Aircraft Labels**: Personalize the look of aircraft labels on the map, including positioning, color, and content.**Advanced Dark Mode**: Enjoy a sleek, bold interface optimized for low-light environments, reducing eye strain during night flights.**Curated Map Styles**: Choose from simple, detailed, hybrid, or satellite maps to suit your preference and enhance your tracking sessions.## About Plane Finder

apps.localizedDescription:
**Gameplay Introduction**
Chronicle of Immortals is an idle cultivation game featuring stunning Japanese-style artwork. Step onto the Immortal Path at your own pace and indulge in a relaxed cultivation experience. You will assume the role of a cultivator striving for immortality and the profound Way, progressively achieving breakthroughs in your Cultivation Base Stage. Face the formidable Tribulation to defy the heavens and ascend as an immortal. Along this journey, multiple beautiful companions will accompany you, ensuring the path to immortality is filled with camaraderie and support.
---
## Game Worldview
The story unfolds in Jiuzhou Continent, an ancient land where Qi flows abundantly and various races coexist. This land is steeped in history, where cultivators and demons once waged a great war. The Silent Heaven Demon Lord was ultimately defeated by the united forces of the Sects. Although the demon race retreated to secluded realms, the aftermath left Jiuzhou scarred, with spiritual veins severed and the path to immortality increasingly obscured.
Amid the chaos, Lady Li, the leader of the Heaven of the Way Sect, rises to uphold the balance and destiny of this world. Facing the challenge of restoring order, she seeks hidden opportunities to overcome the crisis. The Celestial Mystery Pavilion predicts the coming of a “Child of Destiny” destined to heal Jiuzhou’s wounds and reopen the path to immortality. To find this beacon of hope, Lady Li organizes the Hidden Dragon Tournament, gathering ambitious cultivators across the land.
Young cultivators from diverse backgrounds — including Sword Cultivators, alchemists, Fox Spirits, human-demon hybrids, royalty, and strategists — converge at the Heaven of the Way Sect. Their fateful encounters will rewrite history and unlock ancient secrets. You play the pivotal role in this epic tale of destiny.
---
## Realm Background: Jiuzhou Chronicle Preface
In Jiuzhou’s vast realm, rivers flow endlessly toward the sea, while spiritual veins resembling dragons and serpents lie hidden underground, nurturing all life and culturing practitioners of the Way. However, a millennium ago, a devastating conflict between humans and demons shattered mountains and rivers, severed spiritual veins, and obstructed the immortal path, plunging all beings into suffering.
Though the Silent Heaven Demon Lord once rose alongside powerful Sects, he was ultimately defeated by their alliance. Since then, storms have plagued Jiuzhou, the once mighty have declined, and silence has befallen many races. Only Lady Li remains steadfast, standing as the linchpin between heaven and earth, aware that her strength alone cannot restore the former golden age.
In these troubled times, the prophecy declares that the Child of Destiny will be born — one who will defy the heavens and reignite the path to immortality. This heralds a new beginning for heaven and earth, where destinies cross and intertwine. Whether through the sword that carves a path through chaos, or the bonds of emotion seeking the Way in the mortal realm, the story now rests in your hands. You will write the unfinished chapter of this grand saga.
---
## Game System Overview
As a player, you embody a cultivator on the quest for immortality. Enhance your Cultivation Base by meditation and diligent practice, forge ancient treasures and powerful equipment, craft potent pills, and ultimately ascend in broad daylight to transcend into immortality.
## Main Systems
**Idle Training and Tribulation:** Accumulate Qi and advance your Cultivation Base Stage through Practice within your Cave Dwelling. Upon reaching certain milestones, face the formidable heavenly lightning Tribulation. Successfully defy the heavens and complete Tribulation to upgrade your cultivation level.**Equipment and Ancient Treasure System:** Equip your character with various weapons, armor, and ancient treasures. These items not only boost your attributes but also grant active skills. Strategically combining equipment types greatly influences combat effectiveness.**Forging and Pill Refinement:** Utilize gathered materials in your Cave Dwelling to forge equipment or craft pills. The quality of materials and refinement expertise directly impact the final quality of your creations. Continuous forging and refinement enable you to master your skills and produce superior gear and potions.**Companion System:** Each female companion possesses her own cultivation progress and narrative. These companions support you in battles and share heartfelt romantic storylines, enriching your cultivation journey.**Socializing and Sect Activities:** Join Sects to engage in cooperative challenges against powerful foes, participate in Way discussions, and acquire valuable resources. Increasing your Sect Level grants exclusive rewards, fostering community and collaboration.
Chronicle of Immortals offers a rich, immersive experience combining captivating storytelling, diverse cultivation mechanics, and engaging social elements that will keep you enthralled as you pursue your immortal destiny.

apps.name: Anki
apps.localizedDescription:
**AnkiMobile** is the official mobile companion app to Anki®, a powerful and intelligent flashcard program designed to enhance your learning and memorization experience. Since its launch in 2010 by the lead developer of Anki and AnkiWeb, AnkiMobile has remained a trusted tool for learners worldwide who require efficient, customizable, and effective study solutions on the go.
With AnkiMobile, you gain access to the same advanced learning algorithms and robust functionality as the desktop Anki application, allowing you to seamlessly synchronize your progress and content across your iPhone and other Apple devices. This app empowers you to study anywhere, anytime, with powerful features tailored to optimize your retention and streamline your workflow.
---
## Key Features
**Cloud Synchronization:** AnkiMobile offers a free cloud sync service that keeps your flashcard decks and study progress up to date across multiple devices. Add or edit cards on your desktop and continue studying effortlessly on your iPhone.**Advanced Scheduling Algorithms:** Utilize the proven SM2 and FSRS algorithms to review material at optimal intervals, ensuring you are reminded of information just before you are likely to forget it.**Customizable Interface:** Tailor your study experience with configurable actions for taps and swipes, and personalize tool button layouts for efficient navigation and control.**Comprehensive Statistics:** Access detailed graphs and reports that provide insights into your learning patterns, helping you track progress and stay motivated.**Support for Large Decks:** Manage extensive collections effortlessly, including decks containing over 100,000 cards without performance issues.**Offline Study Capabilities:** All images, audio, and media associated with your cards are stored locally on your device. Study anytime, even without an internet connection.**Powerful Search Functionality:** Find specific cards with complex criteria, such as tags, review history, or content exclusions, and organize them for focused study sessions.**Mathematical Equation Rendering:** Support for MathJax and LaTeX enables display of complex mathematical equations created via the desktop app.**Apple Pencil Support:** Add hand-drawn images and annotations to your cards using the Apple Pencil for enhanced visual learning.
---
## Usage Notes
AnkiMobile is designed to work as a companion to the desktop Anki software, providing full compatibility for syncing and reviewing your flashcards. However, some advanced functions such as modifying note types and creating add-ons are currently only available on the desktop version. While you can study image occlusion cards created on the desktop, you cannot create them within AnkiMobile.
The app supports data import and export through USB cable or AirDrop in addition to the cloud sync service, giving you flexible options to manage your decks.
Purchasing AnkiMobile grants usage across multiple devices linked with the same Apple ID, and Family Sharing is supported except in some regions. Educational institutions are encouraged to explore Apple's Volume Purchase Program for bulk licensing options.

apps.name: Quantumult X
apps.localizedDescription:
Look inside your own traffic: **Quantumult X** is a network utility for people who debug web requests or tune their proxies, and you can download the Quantumult X IPA for iPhone straight from builds.io.
## What is Quantumult X?
The App Store lists it under Utilities with Developer Tools as the second genre, and the developer is Cross Utility Ltd. It is a ground-up rebuild of the earlier Quantumult, not a patch of the old code. The audience splits in two: web developers who want visibility into HTTP activity, and users who need control over where their connections go.
For developers, the app can record complete HTTP requests and responses, bodies included, once the HTTP debug option is turned on. MitM decryption covers traffic that arrives through the TUN interface when MitM is enabled. The rewrite engine can answer with a 302 or 307 redirect, or edit request and response headers and bodies on the fly. Per-domain DNS settings, for IPv4 or IPv6, are handled through the configuration profile rather than through menus.
For proxy users, the app speaks the Shadowsocks protocol, including the obfs-tls and obfs-http plugins, and Shadowsocks running over WebSocket and TLS when the server side is deployed with v2ray-core. UDP relay works if the server allows it. Request routing is driven by filters that match a full host, a host suffix or a keyword, so different traffic can follow different policies.
---
## Quantumult X key features
HTTP activity capture with full request and response bodiesMitM decryption for traffic coming through the TUN interfaceRewrite rules for redirects and header or body editsCustom DNS for chosen domainsShadowsocks with obfs plugins, WebSocket and TLS transportsUDP relay where the server supports itPolicy filters by host, suffix or keyword## Price and requirements
This is a paid app in the App Store, listed at 9.99 USD, and the listing here is the regular release of the app. It first appeared in October 2019, needs iOS 15.0 or later and has a 4+ rating. The latest release notes mention optimisation for iPhone Duo. Debug, MitM and rewrite functions each have to be enabled by the user, and the DNS overrides are configured in the profile file.
To get started, open the Quantumult X page on builds.io and send it to your iPhone with one tap, no PC.

**It presents the most accurate and scientifically immersive human evolution experience available on iOS.****Combines educational content with addictive gameplay, making learning about evolution fun and engaging.****Offers a unique blend of history, science, and future speculation, surrounding the continuous development of life.****Beautiful visuals and sound design create a compelling atmosphere for players of all ages interested in evolution, life sciences, and strategy games.**
Will humanity survive the next phase of evolution? The story is yours to write with every tap.

Find the green marker, nose the car in: **Caucasus Parking** is a 3D parking simulator, and you can download the Caucasus Parking IPA for iPhone with unlimited coins. It installs through builds.io.
## About Caucasus Parking
The App Store title is Caucasus Parking with the Russian subtitle Парковка 3D, and the developer is Mikhail Belonogov, in Games under Racing and Simulation. Each level drops your car at a random place on the map. The goal is to locate the bay highlighted by a green marker and park there with the front wheels facing inward. There are 104 levels, and finishing all of them earns a title the developer calls a true fussologist.
The setting is the southern streets of Russia and the Caucasus. The author drew on the nature and architecture of the region, with buildings modelled on cities including Krasnodar, Makhachkala, Derbent, Grozny and Sochi. Over twenty cars are available, from the popular LADA to BMW, Mercedes, Audi, Nissan, Aston Martin and Bugatti, and there is even an Investigative Committee car.
Controls and options suit different tastes: accelerometer, on-screen wheel or arrow keys, two camera modes, and an option to hide the interface for clean screenshots. Cars can be tuned with paint and several wheel choices, and driving physics aim for realism.

**Rogue with the Dead** is a unique roguelike RPG where you command and power up troops on an endless, looping journey that challenges your strategy and decision-making. Embrace the mantra: what kills you makes you stronger, as every defeat leads to new strengths and opportunities.

Along the way, you’ll engage in battles, complete quests, and gather resources to enhance your troops’ abilities. Your soldiers fight automatically, allowing you the choice to watch the battle unfold or jump into the fight yourself.
Soldiers respawn when defeated, but you do not. Upon death, you lose all soldiers, money, and items, except for artifacts, which carry over between runs. Explore a captivating pixel art world filled with rich stories and memorable characters. Journey alongside your troops and your enigmatic guide, Elly, as you traverse towards the Demon Lord’s castle. Gradually uncover the mysterious events that occurred before your arrival and delve into Elly’s hidden past.
## Watch Your Power Grow Exponentially
Start by dealing mere tens or hundreds of damage points. With continuous upgrades, witness your attacks grow into millions, billions, and even trillions. Revel in the rewarding feeling of exponential growth as your strength scales dramatically.
## Diverse Troop Roster
**Swordsman:** A frontline warrior with high health who protects your forces.**Ranger:** A skilled archer attacking from afar, balanced by slower speed and lower health.**Pigmy:** A diminutive warrior with low health and attack but exceptional speed and stealth.**Sorcerer:** A fragile but powerful magician capable of dealing area damage....and many more units to discover and master.## Artifacts to Empower Your Journey

This makes **Rogue with the Dead** ideal for short play sessions and filling those small pockets of free time.

## What is PixelMe?
The App Store lists the app as AI Pixel Art Camera - PixelMe. It was made by Kazuya Saito, sits in Graphics and Design, and has been available since February 2021. The pitch is a two-stage workflow: first an AI model studies your picture and produces a pixel-art base automatically, then you take over and correct it by hand. The developer contrasts this with ordinary filters, which only shrink the resolution and leave you with a blocky copy of the original.
The editor is deliberately simple. You move a cursor over the canvas, tap to draw or erase, pick colours with a colour picker and zoom in to place single dots precisely. Resolution and level of detail can be adjusted to suit your own style. Typical uses named by the developer are profile pictures for Twitter, Instagram, Discord and TikTok, retro game assets, and general digital art made from selfies, portraits and landscapes.
Compared with a one-tap pixelate filter, the benefit is control. The AI gives you a starting grid within seconds, and every dot after that is yours to move, recolour or erase, which is why the store compares the result to dot art drawn by a pixel artist rather than a shrunken photo.
When the piece is done you export it in high quality, send it straight to a social network or keep it in the camera roll.

apps.name: Nonograms Katana
apps.localizedDescription:
**Nonograms Katana** is a premium puzzle game designed to sharpen your mind with addictive and challenging logic puzzles known as Nonograms. Also referred to as Hanjie, Griddlers, Picross, Japanese Crosswords, or Paint by Numbers, Nonograms require players to reveal hidden pictures by coloring or leaving blank cells within a grid based on numerical clues provided at the edges of the grid.
The numbers indicate how many continuous filled squares appear in each row or column, with at least one empty square separating different blocks. For example, a clue such as "4 8 3" signifies sets of four, eight, and three filled squares respectively, separated by at least one blank cell. Solving these puzzles involves careful logical deduction about which cells to fill (also called boxes) and which to leave empty (called spaces). Marking certain empty cells with symbols such as dots or crosses helps in the deduction process and prevents guessing, as every step must be supported by logic to avoid errors that could ruin the entire puzzle.
---
## Core Features
Enjoy a vast collection of **1001 unique Nonograms** of varying complexity.All puzzles are **completely free** to play with no restrictions.Every puzzle is **computer-tested** to ensure **a unique logical solution** without guessing.Play both **classic black-and-white** puzzles or exciting **colored** versions for variety.Choose puzzles sized from **5x5 up to 50x50**, sorted into groups according to difficulty and size.Download and solve puzzles **shared by the community**.Create your own puzzles and **share them** with other players for unlimited new challenges.Use up to **15 free hints per puzzle** to help when you get stuck.Mark cells confidently with **crosses, dots, and other symbols** to track your deductions.**Auto-cross out** numbers that have been fully accounted for to keep your focus sharp.**Auto-fill** trivial or completed lines to speed up solving.The game **auto-saves your progress** so you can pause and resume anytime.**Zoom and smooth scrolling** provide comfortable navigation through large puzzles.**Lock and zoom number bars** to keep crucial clues visible while you scroll.**Lock your current puzzle state** to check assumptions without losing progress.Customize the game’s **background** for a personalized experience.An **optional cursor** improves accuracy when selecting cells.**Undo and redo** your moves to experiment safely.Share your completed nonogram results as pictures with friends.**Cloud saving** lets you secure your game progress across devices on iOS.Achievements and leaderboards add a competitive edge and track your progress.Supports **screen rotation** for landscape or portrait playing.Made to run smoothly on both phones and tablets running iOS.
---
**Nonograms Katana** combines classic puzzle-solving mechanics with modern interface enhancements to provide an enjoyable and mentally stimulating experience for all ages. Whether you are a beginner or a seasoned nonogram veteran, the extensive puzzle library guarantees hours of fun and brain training without distractions or interruptions.
Master the art of picture logic puzzles and unlock hidden images that provide a satisfying sense of accomplishment. This app encourages logical thinking, attention to detail, and patience, making it a perfect pastime for intellectual gamers.

**Steam Link** sends your Steam games from a computer to your phone, and on this page you can download the Steam Link IPA for iOS to run it on iPhone or iPad. The streaming happens over your own home network.
## About Steam Link
The idea behind the app is simple. The game keeps running on your computer, and only the picture and controls travel between the two devices. That lets a phone or tablet show titles that it could never run natively, and it means your whole library is within reach without installing anything extra on the handheld. The app was designed with low lag in mind, since delay between a press and the response on screen is the main thing that ruins streamed play.
Control is flexible. When you want a console-like feel, pair a compatible controller with the phone. When you do not have a gamepad nearby, the on-screen touch controls take over, so you can still play from the sofa or from another room. The interface is intentionally plain and quick to understand.

## What is Dropshare?
The App Store title is Dropshare - File Sharing Tool, from the developer Timo Josten, under Productivity and Utilities. Instead of keeping your files on its own servers, the app pushes them to storage you already use, then hands back a download URL to paste anywhere. That can be your own server, an S3-compatible bucket or a popular cloud drive.
The list of supported destinations is long. Object storage includes Amazon S3, Backblaze B2, DigitalOcean Spaces, Google Cloud Storage, Azure Blob Storage, MinIO and Hetzner. Drive-style services include Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Box, pCloud and Nextcloud. Image hosts such as Imgur and Flickr are covered, and so are protocols like SFTP, FTP/FTPS, SCP and WebDAV, which need a working server account.
Uploading is built into the way iOS shares things: choose files from Photos or Files, or use the Share Extension in another app. One file, many files or a ZIP archive can go in a single upload. The upload history syncs across iPhone, iPad and Mac through iCloud, links can run through a custom domain or a shortener such as Bitly or the built-in dsh.re, and download pages can be styled to match your identity. Shortcuts support lets you automate it all.

apps.name: Zerocam | Anti-AI Camera
apps.localizedDescription:
**Zerocam** is a pure digital camera app that brings point-and-shoot photography back to your iPhone with simplicity and charm. It transforms your device into a small pocket camera designed for fun and effortless photo capturing.
Unlike professional cameras with large lenses, complex settings, and hardware controls, your phone's camera has a tiny sensor and a plastic lens. While not perfect, this setup carries a unique character. **Zerocam embraces this natural charm** by highlighting natural noise, a soft pleasant look, and subtle in-camera color grading to create photos that feel authentic and timeless.
Most stock camera apps use aggressive AI postprocessing to fix imperfections, often resulting in unnatural images with an unmistakable HDR appearance and flatness. Zerocam rejects this trend and delivers pure, natural photos without artificial enhancements.
---
## Zero Interface
Zerocam eliminates all distractions so you can focus on photography instead of fiddling with camera settings. Today’s mobile photo apps often overwhelm users with numerous features, exposure adjustments, focusing taps, and mode switches—making it easy to miss the decisive moment. We designed Zerocam to be the most accessible camera app ever.
The interface features a giant shutter button and no settings to adjust; all corrections and optimizations are preconfigured by us. There is **no focus control**, no exposure correction, no complex modes—just a simple click, and the app handles the rest. This experience is reminiscent of using a classic disposable camera, where you simply point, shoot, and enjoy the results.
---
## Authentic Photography Experience
Zerocam is designed for those who believe photography is about storytelling without distractions. There are no artificial postprocessing effects that ruin your photo with fake details or bloated interfaces that confuse the user. Instead, Zerocam delivers the essence of photography—capturing moments naturally and beautifully.
---
## How Zerocam Works
Captures temporary RAW data behind the scenes for accurate color processing.Automatically converts the RAW to a flat image, preserving natural tones.Applies a custom subtle lookup table (LUT) crafted to enhance the photo's look.Saves the final image as a compressed JPEG ready to share.
---
## Frequently Asked Questions
**Does Zerocam shoot RAW?** – No. Zerocam uses RAW internally for processing but exports final images as JPEGs.**Why no RAW shooting option?** – RAW is a professional format requiring further editing. Zerocam focuses on simplicity and immediate great results.**Where are the settings?** – There are none. Zerocam is designed for zero-configuration shooting.**How is focus handled?** – The focus is fixed on the middle of the frame, like a classic pocket camera.**Is there a selfie camera option?** – No dedicated selfie mode. Simply flip your device and shoot with the higher-quality primary camera.**Why so minimal?** – To make photography accessible and straightforward for everyone.**What happens when I press the shutter?** – Zerocam captures RAW data, processes it with the best available settings adjusted for light and scene, applies the custom color grading, and saves the image instantly.

apps.localizedDescription:
Summer job, oceanfront shop, a queue of impatient customers: **Papa's Freezeria To Go** is a time-management game about perfect sundaes. Get the Papa's Freezeria To Go IPA for iPhone and take over the counter.
## What is Papa's Freezeria To Go?
The game comes from Flipline Studios, the creators of the Papa Louie series, and the App Store lists it as Papa's Freezeria To Go! under Games. It is a version of the original Papa's Freezeria rebuilt around touch input on iPhone and iPod Touch. You start a relaxing summer job at an ice cream shop by the sea, and then every customer of Papa Louie turns up on the island at once.
Each order moves through four stations that you hop between. At the Order Station you watch the lobby and take tickets. The Build Station is where ice cream and mixables go into the cup, and the Mix Station is for blending the sundae until it is just right. Finally, the Top Station adds whipped cream and toppings before the dish goes to a demanding customer. Every station is hands-on, and each step is done by dragging, swiping or tapping.
Good work pays off in points and levels. A higher level adds new toppings to the shop and new customers to the queue, while well-made sundaes earn tips that buy upgrades and decorations for the lobby. The To Go edition adjusts the layout for small screens: stations switch with buttons in the corners, the Pour Button and Bonus Meter sit at the side where a thumb can reach them, and the mixable and syrup menus fill the whole screen with large buttons.
---

Controls arranged for thumbs on a small screen
Over seventy ingredients, from mixables to syrups and toppings
85 customers with their own orders, along with Closers and a Food Critic
120 achievements to collect while you level up

Film colour straight from the sensor: **Analogue** shoots in LOG for that film look, and you can download the Analogue IPA for iPhone with the subscription unlocked. It installs from builds.io.
## About Analogue
The App Store name is Analogue - Film Camera, by the developer Cristian Teichner, in the Photo & Video category. The idea is to deliver cinematic colour, soft highlight roll-off and natural contrast at the moment of capture, without filters, tone mapping or heavy sharpening, so most shots need no editing afterwards. It is aimed at photographers who like a softer, filmic look.
There are two capture modes. Cine records in LOG for softer, less processed images, while Pro uses Bayer RAW for sharper, more detailed ones, and both carry the same look. RAW files can be saved as DNG, as processed images, or both, and DNGs can be reprocessed later in Analogue Studio, where you also adjust exposure, white balance, tint, crop and rotation. Video works in SDR, P3 and HLG, with presets and LUTs applied to all three.
Looks are handled through real-time presets that you can preview before shooting, save as custom styles and organise. You can import your own LUTs and tune them live, or begin with one of six built-in base looks, from the neutral one to a classic negative emulation. Other tools include Film Scan, film grain, Super Resolution at 12, 24 or 33 megapixels, a histogram with highlight clipping, Kelvin white balance, manual focus and exposure locking, with a 180-degree shutter angle bias for video.

Welcome to a grim dystopian future where a totalitarian State exercises absolute control over every aspect of both private and public life. In this oppressive world, laws are harsh, surveillance is relentless, and privacy has become a thing of the past. Your primary duty is to secretly monitor their activities and eavesdrop on their conversations. You must install bugs in their apartments while they are away, search their belongings for any information that might threaten the authority of the State, and compile detailed profiles for your superiors. ## What is Noise Maker?
Noise Maker is a soundscape app from the developer Bence Erno Borsos, listed in the App Store as Noise Maker: Relax and Sleep under Health & Fitness. The idea is simple: instead of one looping track, you build the background you actually want. Steady broadband sounds such as white, pink and brown noise sit next to natural textures like ocean waves and rainfall, plus mechanical hums from fans and similar sources.
The part that sets it apart from a plain white-noise player is layering. You can stack several sounds at once and balance them against each other, for example a soft rain bed with a low brown-noise rumble underneath, then save the result as a favorite and bring it back with one tap on a later night. The interface is deliberately minimal, which matters at bedtime: it is meant to stay readable and easy to operate in a dark room without hunting through menus.
The store page names four everyday uses: winding down after a long day, masking distractions to concentrate, helping you drift off, and covering ringing in the ears with a gentle steady sound. ## About ReFrame
The App Store lists the app as ReFrame: Dual Camera Recorder, published by Damien and Nathanael Elledge in the Photo & Video category. It solves a very specific annoyance for people who post to several platforms. A normal camera forces a choice before you press record, and if you picked wrong, the footage has to be cropped or reshot. ReFrame saves a 16:9 clip suited to YouTube and a 9:16 clip suited to Reels, Shorts and TikTok from the same recording.

apps.name: Botanicula
apps.localizedDescription:
Follow five tiny tree creatures on a quest in **Botanicula**. Get the Botanicula IPA on your iPhone and explore a hand-drawn world that rewards curiosity rather than speed.
## What is Botanicula?
Botanicula is an adventure game from the Czech studio Amanita Design s.r.o., the team behind Machinarium and the Samorost series. Its music comes from the Czech band DVA. In the App Store it sits under Games with Family and Adventure tags.
The story is simple and told without long speeches. Five friends, who are little creatures living in a tree, set out to rescue the last seed of their home. Evil parasites have infested the tree, and the journey takes the group through its branches and the odd places that grow on them.
Its look and sound are the main draw. The world is hand-drawn, the soundtrack was written by the band DVA and has an award for audio on its résumé, and the developer says the game suits gamers, their partners, families and seniors alike, so it works as a title to share on the couch.
The pace is deliberately relaxed. There is no timer and no pressure, which is why the developer pitches it equally to veteran gamers, to their partners, to families and to seniors. You click around the screen to find out what each creature, plant or insect does, trigger funny reactions and uncover hidden extras that are easy to miss.
---

Over 150 hand-drawn locations, each full of small detailsFunny animations by the hundred, from every creature you meetPlenty of hidden bonuses for players who like to poke at everythingOriginal music by DVA, which has won an audio awardCalm, family-friendly adventure with no time pressureRecognition on the store page, including an IndieCade award for story and world design and a game-of-the-year title from jayisgames.com## Price and requirements

apps.name: RRS EQ3
apps.localizedDescription:
**EQ3 AUv3 plug-in** offers a unique and vintage-inspired approach to tonal adjustments for your audio projects. Originally pioneered in the 1980s, this equalizer stands out by shaping frequencies through summing broad, overlapping bandpasses instead of the traditional method of boosting or cutting specific bands. This vintage methodology is faithfully emulated and enhanced using modern digital technology to provide you with a warm, musical, and highly controllable equalization experience.
The EQ3 features five broad, interacting bands at 10 Hz (Sub), 40 Hz, 160 Hz, 650 Hz, and 2.5 kHz. In addition, there is a specialized "rock (airy) band" control that provides high-frequency boost-only shaping, perfect for adding brightness and clarity to your mix. These wide, approximately 2-octave bands smoothly overlap, allowing subtle and natural tonal adjustments that differ from the sharp notches or narrow cuts found in many typical equalizers.
Using the EQ3 requires a bit of experimentation to master, as the controls interact in complex and musical ways. For example, boosting the 10 kHz rock band to a higher level might require you to slightly reduce the 2.5 kHz band to maintain a flat and balanced response. This technique emphasizes clarity and airiness in the high frequencies. Similarly, the same approach applies to the lower frequency bands to achieve a rich and well-defined bass response. The result is an equalizer that can reach into your mix with minimal phase distortion while offering a distinctive sonic character.
---
## Key Features
Standalone app and AUv3 plug-in compatibility for seamless integration into your iOS audio workflow.Precise port of the classic Rack Extensions plug-in, ensuring fidelity to the original hardware tone.Modeled vintage EQ design replicating the warmth and character of analog gear.Unique boost-only shelves at 2.5 kHz, 5 kHz, 10 kHz, 20 kHz, and 40 kHz for subtle high-frequency enhancements.Fixed boost and cut shelves and bells across all frequency bands, including sub-bass control at 10 Hz.Flexible stereo processing with Mono, Mid, and Side EQ modes for precise spatial control.Powerful workflow features such as Undo/Redo and A/B comparison to refine your sound efficiently.High-quality upsampling options at 2x, 4x, and 8x to ensure pristine audio fidelity.Scalable, user-friendly graphical interface making it easy to fine-tune your EQ settings on any screen size.## Usage
To use the EQ3 AUv3 plug-in, simply open it within any AUv3-compatible host app such as GarageBand, Auria, AUM, Cubasis, and others. It will appear among the available Audio Unit extensions for effect plug-ins, ready for immediate deployment in your audio projects. Whether you're mixing, mastering, or sound designing, EQ3 provides a versatile tool for creative tonal shaping with a vintage sonic flavor.
Remember, the broad and overlapping nature of the EQ bands means that subtle adjustments can have significant impact. Take some time to experiment and listen closely to how the bands interact to develop an intuitive understanding of this unique equalizer.

apps.localizedDescription:
Keep every coin accounted for with **Fin - Budget Tracker**. Get the Fin - Budget Tracker tweak IPA on your iPhone and the paid tier is already switched on, so nothing in the budgeting toolkit sits behind a paywall.
## About Fin - Budget Tracker
Fin is a personal finance app from the developer Thomas Brandstaetter, listed in the App Store as Fin: Budget Planner App under Finance and Lifestyle. Its pitch is deliberately low-friction: you open it and start entering numbers, with no sign-up screen, and it keeps working without a connection.
Day to day you log what came in and what went out, then sort each entry into a category. Categories can be recolored and given an emoji, which makes a long list scannable at a glance. A transaction is not just an amount: you can pin a photo, a PDF, the weather and a location to it, so the receipt for a repair or a dinner stays attached to the line it belongs to. Recurring bills can be set up once instead of retyped every month.
The privacy stance is unusual for a finance app. There is no link to your bank, the data stays on the phone, and it only leaves the device if you choose to sync through iCloud. Passcode, Face ID and Touch ID can lock the app on top of that.
---
## What the Fin - Budget Tracker tweak unlocks
Subscription features open without paying, as stated in the changelog of this buildSeveral accounts side by side, for example a wallet, a card and a savings potReceipt scanning, with Live Text support listed on the store pageInteractive charts plus a map view that plots spending by placeCSV import to bring in history exported from a bank or card statementHome and Lock Screen widgets, Siri Shortcuts and Focus FiltersA currency converter covering more than 150 world currencies, with the interface translated into over 20 languagesFour app themes and alternative app icons## Version and requirements
The regular App Store edition is free to install and has been around since mid-2020; it asks for iOS 15.0 or later. The difference in this build is the unlocked subscription, nothing else is rewritten. The most recent store notes mention a fix for a Face ID and Touch ID unlock loop and smoother editing of recurring transactions.
Ready to see where your money goes? Grab Fin from builds.io, tap to install the IPA, and your iPhone gets the full planner without a computer or a card on file.

## What is WL Analysis?
WL Analysis, shown in the App Store as Easy Video Analysis for weightlifting, is a sports tool by the developer Karol Smolak. It has been listed since December 2020 and is free to download. You film a lift, import the clip, and the app estimates what the bar did: its path through the movement, speed, power, force and horizontal drift.
The detection is automatic. There is no need to mark the plate by hand, because the app finds the barbell itself and draws the trajectory over your video. The line can be colored by velocity, power or force, which shows at a glance where a lift slows down or drifts forward. The developer is upfront that these numbers are approximations from phone footage, so they suit technique review rather than lab measurement.
Comparison is the other strong side. Two videos can be placed side by side or stacked as an overlay, which makes it simple to check a good rep against a failed one or this month against last month. Playback speed is adjustable, you can step one frame at a time, and you can zoom into the exact moment a pull goes wrong. The tool is aimed at every barbell discipline: Olympic weightlifting, powerlifting, CrossFit and similar work.

apps.name: Web Video Cast
apps.localizedDescription:
**Web Video Caster®** is a powerful application designed to stream videos from your favorite websites directly to your TV. Whether it's movies, TV shows, live news, or sports, this app lets you effortlessly enjoy your preferred online content on a larger screen for an enhanced viewing experience.
The app supports a wide array of streaming devices, allowing you to connect and cast videos seamlessly. From popular streaming gadgets to smart TVs, Web Video Caster® ensures broad compatibility to accommodate your entertainment setup.
---
## Supported Streaming Devices
**Google Cast devices:** Chromecast, Android TV, Chromecast built-in**DLNA devices:** Includes Xbox, Samsung TVs, LG TVs and more**Roku family:** Roku, Roku stick, and Roku TVs**Apple TV 4****Fire TV:** Fire TV and Fire TV stick**PlayStation 4** via its web browser**Most web browsers:** Access casting through supported browsers on various smart TVs, consoles, and set-top boxes## Supported Media Formats
**HLS live streams:** in M3U8 format (not supported by Chromecast and most DLNA devices)**Authenticated videos:** includes licensed movies and TV shows**MP4 videos****Live news and sports broadcasts****HTML5 videos** from websites
Please note that your streaming device must be capable of decoding the video format you are playing. Web Video Caster® itself does not perform any video or audio decoding or transcoding.
## How Web Video Caster® Works
This app functions as a specialized browser that locates and extracts the video URL embedded within a web page. Instead of playing the video on your mobile device, it sends the URL directly to your streaming device. The video then plays on your TV by streaming from the original content provider’s server. This approach conserves your mobile device’s battery life during playback. The app also detects available subtitles on web pages to enhance your viewing options.
Importantly, Web Video Caster® does not host any videos or media content – it strictly serves as a conduit for streaming content hosted elsewhere. This is not a screen mirroring app; instead, the streaming device plays the content natively.
---
## Get Started in Just a Few Steps
Browse online to find a video you want to watch.Ensure that the video can be played in mobile browsers without requiring Flash.Connect your mobile device to your streaming device or smart TV.Play the video through the app’s interface or select the play button in the toolbar to begin casting.
---
## Limitations and Important Notes
The app is not affiliated with any web media providers and does not control third-party content.Flash and FLV video formats are not supported.The app does not support tab casting such as the Chromecast browser extension for PCs.Playback issues related to the content provider’s server side, including buffering and failure to play, are beyond the app’s control and may occur during peak usage times.
---
## Customer Support and Feedback
We encourage open communication to provide the best user experience possible. Please reach out to support first for any questions or technical issues instead of leaving a review immediately. The team is committed to responding promptly and addressing your concerns to ensure smooth usage of the app.
